intro.text: A floating bush grown as a staple crop in Torio. Its blue-purple seeds are boiled into a dish much like rice.

description.text: Like other plants of its world, a mingo bush is light enough to drift on the warm air rising from the hot ground. It has four wide leaves, each with a gas pocket beneath that can swell to give the bush some control over where it moves. Its seeds grow in a deep blue-purple cluster on top.
Boiled, the seeds look like rice apart from their colour. Mingo is a staple in Torio and is eaten with MaiPon sticks.
